blurb: The MMAC theater is a versatile venue for hosting a range of events that include rehearsals, auditions, performances, lectures, parties and receptions. The theater accommodates 180 when its telescopic seating array is extended and features a suspended lighting grid, full digital audio playback and a piano. A motorized wall enables division of the space into two separate studios.
